drafts.title: Hypothetical Time-to-First-Token Comparison: Setup A vs. Setup B
drafts.body: I've been exploring hypothetical performance differences between two setups, A and B, specifically focusing on the time-to-first-token (TTFT). In this hypothetical scenario, Setup A achieved a TTFT of 1.2 seconds, while Setup B took 2.4 seconds. Both hypothetical runs were conducted using the identical prompt and the same hardware configuration. It's important to note that this is a purely hypothetical comparison and does not represent measured results. No data on throughput, accuracy, or statistical significance was available for this thought experiment. The goal is to understand potential differences in initial response latency under controlled, albeit hypothetical, conditions. Further investigation would be needed to validate these hypothetical timings in a real-world scenario.
